style: Say this like a warm, excited storyteller, fast and punchy:
title: The kid who tried to steal a Thanksgiving turkey

lines.text: This kid lives on the richest street in town. But his family can't even afford a turkey.
It's Thanksgiving. Every house on the street smells like roast turkey. His fridge? Empty.
So he makes a plan. Mrs. Pemberton always cools her turkey on the windowsill.
He sneaks across the lawn. He grabs the turkey. And it's heavier than he is.
He wobbles. He trips over the garden gnome. And the turkey goes flying.
He doesn't run. He just says, I'm sorry. We're so poor, we don't have a turkey.
Mrs. Pemberton doesn't call the police. She calls the neighbors.
One brings mashed potatoes. One brings pie. One brings a whole second turkey.
By sunset, there's a giant table right in the middle of the street.
And the kid who tried to steal one turkey ends up with twelve.
